info.name: EVE Swagger Interface Alliance Planetary Interaction API

params.name: character_id
params.description: An EVE character ID

params.name: datasource
params.description: The server name you would like data from

params.name: token
params.description: Access token to use if unable to set a header

items.docs:
Returns a list of all planetary colonies owned by a character.

---
Alternate route: `/dev/characters/{character_id}/planets/`

Alternate route: `/legacy/characters/{character_id}/planets/`

Alternate route: `/v1/characters/{character_id}/planets/`

---
This route is cached for up to 600 seconds

params.name: character_id
params.description: An EVE character ID

params.name: datasource
params.description: The server name you would like data from

params.name: planet_id
params.description: Planet id of the target planet

params.name: token
params.description: Access token to use if unable to set a header

items.docs:
Returns full details on the layout of a single planetary colony, including links, pins and routes. Note: Planetary information is only recalculated when the colony is viewed through the client. Information will not update until this criteria is met.

---
Alternate route: `/dev/characters/{character_id}/planets/{planet_id}/`

Alternate route: `/v3/characters/{character_id}/planets/{planet_id}/`
